rules.condition: court.formal_eligible == true and novelty.status in {NEW, DUPLICATE}
rules.note: bank a NEW admission before opening the next mechanism; a DUPLICATE is not parameter-tuned into being called new

rules.condition: constructibility.status == PASS and active_assets is known and active_assets < 12, OR EXTENDED24 active_block_fraction is known and active_block_fraction < 0.25, OR FULLTRAIN active_time_fraction is known and active_time_fraction < 0.02
decision_epochs_in_current_formulation >= 2 and window_summary.best_gross_sum is known and best_gross_sum <= 0
gross_positive == true and net_positive == false and cost_exceeds_gross == true and adequate_support == true
rules.adequate_support_definition: active_assets >= 12 and ((EXTENDED24 and active_block_fraction >= 0.75) or (FULLTRAIN and active_time_fraction >= 0.02))

rules.condition: evaluation_stage == EXTENDED24 and active_block_fraction >= 0.75 and positive_month_pair_means is known and positive_month_pair_means <= 2
rules.note: cost-destruction rule has higher priority; this branch is for replication failure not already dominated by the stronger execution/cost signature

rules.condition: optimizer_active == true and (gross_improvement > 0 or net_improvement > 0) and no higher-priority trigger fired
optimizer_active == true and stagnation_steps >= 2 and no higher-priority trigger fired

action_payload_policy.selection_rule: for CHANGE_* actions, select the first unused legal payload in deterministic frozen order for the requested intervention class; if none remains, ABANDON_BASIN

launch_blocker: freeze deterministic formulation mutation bank/payload ordering
